mapper.select: SELECT al.id, ai.unit, al.Type, al.tip, al.asset_name AS assetName, ai.name, al.url AS Url, al.updatedTime AS updatedTime, ai.use_status AS useStatus FROM attachment al LEFT JOIN asset_info ai ON al.asset_code = ai.code ORDER BY al.id

SELECT al.*, ai.unit AS unit, ai.name AS name ,ai. use_status AS Status FROM attachment al LEFT JOIN asset_info ai ON al.asset_code = ai.code
AND ai.unit LIKE CONCAT('%',#{unit},'%') AND ai.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{name},'%') AND al.asset_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{assetName},'%') AND al.type = #{type} AND al.updatedTime LIKE CONCAT('%',#{updatedTime},'%')
ORDER BY al.id
SELECT id FROM asset_info WHERE code = #{code};
